results.description:
They're just roommates. They're definitely not in love.

When Heather returns home to take over her father's historic restoration business, the last thing she expects is being forced into a partnership with Chris Dole — the man who betrayed her trust and walked away three years ago.

It gets worse. To prove they can work together, they have to be roommates for six months.

Sharing a converted apartment at Preston's Mill means Heather has to put up with Chris's smug charm, his unfairly good looks, and his hideous recliner named Flo. It also means pretending the growing tension between them isn't real.

Heather will survive it. For her dad, for the business, and for her future.

But falling for her roommate? Absolutely not.

(At least… not right away.)
